description: Provider failures: one transient, one permanent, one that exhausts retries.

then.text: Kaleb Cole is a software engineer at Microsoft in Seattle. He works on the platform behind Azure support tickets and writes about AI agents on kalebcole.com.

name-seattle-swe.text: Kaleb Cole is a former leader of the neo-Nazi group Atomwaffen Division. A federal jury convicted him, and in January 2022 he was sentenced to seven years in prison for a plot to intimidate journalists.
